about_the_game:
Children all over the world (and even some adults) have been sending you letters, asking for just one thing: they wish their parents could be happier and come home earlier, instead of working endless hours for low wages.

As Santa, it’s your mission to fulfill their wishes by destroying the root of all evil—the greedy CEOs who exploit their employees and steal the joy from families.

This holiday season, it’s PAYBACK TIME!!!

Play as Santa Claus and take on corrupt CEOs who have drained the joy from their employees in this over-the-top action-packed adventure.

🎅 TAKE REVENGE as Santa!!!

Step into Santa’s boots and punish evil CEOs who exploit their workers & customers, reclaiming happiness for the holidays!

💥 HUGE COLLECTION of Weaponry!!!

Use a wide range of powerful weapons to take down enemies in wild and satisfying ways. Upgrade your Arsenal to become the Ultimate Xmas Avenger.

👔 CORPORATE Bosses & Enemies!!!

Face off against outrageous enemies from the world of business, each with their own unique twists, challenges, and attacks.

🎲 RANDOMLY GENERATED Levels!!!

No two playthroughs are ever the same! Explore dynamic levels that keep every experience fresh and unpredictable. 

Enjoy an Infinitely Re-Playable game in Randomly Generated Worlds for each run!

Get ready to save the holiday spirit, one CEO at a time!!!

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains satirical themes and humor that explore corporate greed and business culture. While there is no explicit sexual content or extreme violence, the game includes elements of exaggerated violence, destruction of enemies, and may feature humor that touches on mature subjects like exploitation, capitalism, and workplace issues.

Recommended for players 12+ due to cartoonish violence, social commentary, and thematic content.

short_description: Santa's Hitlist: CEO Edition is a single-player, top-down shooter rogue-lite game where you play as Santa, avenging average workers by taking down their CEOs. Armed with a vast arsenal of weapons, you'll face off against epic bosses from the business world in your quest for justice.
